segments.HAG.1.1-2: The LORD speaks to the leaders about rebuilding the temple
segments.HAG.1.7-9: The LORD tells the people to build his house
segments.HAG.1.10-11: The LORD sends drought on the land because of the people
segments.HAG.1.12-13: The people obey, and the LORD says he is with the people
segments.HAG.1.14-15: The LORD stirs the leaders and people to begin the work
segments.HAG.2.1-2: The LORD tells Haggai to speak to the leaders
segments.HAG.2.3-5: The LORD tells the leaders and people to be strong and work
segments.HAG.2.8-9: The LORD says the later temple will have greater glory
segments.HAG.2.10-12: Haggai asks the priests whether holy meat makes food holy
segments.HAG.2.13-14: Haggai says the people and the offerings are defiled
segments.HAG.2.15-17: The LORD reminds the people that harvests were small
segments.HAG.2.18-19: The LORD promises to bless the people from this day
segments.HAG.2.20-22: The LORD tells Zerubbabel he will overturn the kingdoms
segments.HAG.2.23-23: The LORD chooses Zerubbabel as his signet ring
